description: Distill verified code execution traces into tested, reusable functions in the persistent skill vault while compacting older episodic logs. Use after coding milestones to extract skills; use `oxyo_consolidate` for episode cleanup without skill synthesis.

keep_recent.description: Number of newest episodes retained verbatim during memory compaction.

max_new_skills.description: Maximum number of newly synthesized skills promoted in one pass (1..10).

traces.description: Optional verified trace objects [{'prompt': ..., 'verified_code': ...}] to abstract.

name: oxyo_sleep_abstract
